title: LAX Sunset Sessions
description: Nightly DJs and live bands on the beach deck. The default Cabarete evening — no cover most nights.

title: Malecón Evening Food Kiosks
description: Street food, cold Presidentes, and típico drifting from the waterfront stalls every evening.

title: Kite Beach Wind Session
description: Morning kite and wing lessons, races, and beach hangouts when the trade winds kick in — most days here.

title: Liquid Blue Sunrise Yoga
description: Beach sunrise yoga with Liquid Blue instructors on Kite Beach — calm flows to start your day, all levels welcome. Class times vary; WhatsApp +1 (849) 271-9573 to confirm the schedule and book your spot.

title: Cowork Cabarete Open Desk & Coffee
description: Remote workers and founders coworking weekdays — informal networking at the bar after 4 PM.

title: El Batey Salsa Social
description: Weekly salsa night — beginner class then social dancing until late. No partner needed.

title: Sosúa Beach Volleyball Pickup
description: Locals and visitors mix teams on the sand every week. Just show up and jump in.

title: LAX Friday Reggae Night
description: Reggae and roots every Friday on the bay — one of Cabarete's longest-running weekly parties.

title: El Batey Open Mic
description: Singers, poets, and comedians sign up at the door. Underground scene, bilingual crowd.

title: Hard Rock Cafe Live Shows
description: Live bands and tribute acts on downtown Sosúa's biggest stage — local rock, pop covers, and touring performers on peak weekend nights.

title: Hard Rock Billed Concerts & Special Events
description: Headliner nights at Hard Rock Cafe Sosúa — merengue, bolero, tribute acts, and touring artists as listed on the official event calendar. Tickets at the Rock Shop (Calle Duarte / Calle Beller) or WhatsApp +1 849-505-7778.

title: Chill & Grill Classic Rock Night
description: Classic rock and dad-rock covers at Chill & Grill (Casa Linda) — expat hub with wing specials and a clubhouse stage every Wednesday.
address: Residencial Casa Linda, Carretera El Choco

title: Hotel Voramar BBQ & Live Music
description: Poolside Friday nights at Hotel Voramar — alternating BBQ feasts and live rock/pop cover bands with a relaxed German-Caribbean crowd.

title: Smiley's Live Music Saturdays
description: Saturday live sets at Smiley's courtyard bar on Pedro Clisante — cover bands, karaoke energy, and one of Sosúa's most reliable expat hangouts.

title: The Finish Line Live Music
description: Midweek live music at The Finish Line pub — acoustic sets and cover bands in a familiar expat sports-bar setting on the main strip.

title: Playa Sosúa Live Music
description: Weekend evenings along Playa Sosúa — informal sets and DJ nights at beachfront bars including Bar 39 and the strip facing the bay.

title: Cheers Bar Live Music
description: Weekly live bands at Cheers Bar & Grill on Pedro Clisante — rock and blues covers, sports-pub atmosphere, and one of Sosúa's most reliable expat hangouts for live entertainment.

title: Señor Rock Live Bands
description: Nightly live music at Señor Rock in Playa Dorada Plaza — local bands playing rock, pop covers, and Caribbean favorites with dinner and drinks.

title: Cremo Salsa Night
description: Friday salsa night at Cremo Cigar Bar downtown — live Latin music, dancing, and Dominican rum specials in the historic center.

title: Sábado Bailable at Victrola 037
description: Saturday dance night at Victrola 037 Arte Café on the Puerto Plata Malecón — salsa, merengue, and bachata from 10:00 PM, open until 1:00 AM. Drinks, good music, and a waterfront crowd.
address: Av. Gral. Gregorio Luperón esq. Padre Castellanos, Puerto Plata 57000

title: Ladies Night at Victrola 037
description: Every Friday at Victrola 037 Arte Café on the Puerto Plata Malecón — live music with Lisbeth Naar, free sangria, and Ladies Night vibes from 7:00–9:00 PM. With Kite Street POP and Café Meclao.
address: Av. Gral. Gregorio Luperón esq. Padre Castellanos, Puerto Plata 57000

title: Cremo Bohemian Night
description: Wednesday live classical music at Cremo — elegant cocktails, cigars, and an intimate downtown atmosphere.

title: Cremo Karaoke Night
description: Saturday karaoke at Cremo Cigar Bar — grab the mic, sing along, and enjoy cocktails with a DJ keeping the energy up.

title: Big Lee's Classic Rock & Karaoke
description: Weekend nights at Big Lee's on Cosita Rica Beach — classic rock on the speakers, karaoke, and beachfront drinks by the Atlantic.

title: Sea Horse Ranch Saturday Market
description: Shop local every Saturday — artisans, fresh food, organic produce, live music, and boutique fashions on the Sea Horse Ranch Tennis Club lawn between Cabarete and Sosúa.
venue: Sea Horse Ranch Tennis Club Lawn

title: Ocean World Adventure Park
description: Ocean World Adventure Park open daily in Cofresí, Puerto Plata — dolphin encounters, sea lion and shark shows, exotic birds, reef snorkeling, and a giant water slide. Plan 4–6 hours. (Often searched as Sea World Puerto Plata.)

title: 27 Charcos de Damajagua — Park Hours
description: Guided waterfall treks through limestone pools — most tours cover seven cascades; full 27-charco route for fit adventurers. ~1 hour from Puerto Plata.

title: Fortaleza San Felipe — Museum Hours
description: 16th-century Spanish fortress and museum — original cannons, colonial weapons, and Atlantic views. Sunset from La Puntilla park nearby.

title: Museo del Ámbar — Museum Hours
description: Puerto Plata's Amber Museum (Museo del Ámbar) — Victorian mansion in the historic center with Dominican amber and fossilized resin, including lizards, scorpions, and insects millions of years old.

title: Museo del Ámbar — Saturday Hours
description: Shorter Saturday hours at the Amber Museum (fossilized resin / Dominican amber) in downtown Puerto Plata. Closed Sundays.

title: Teleférico Puerto Plata — Cable Car
description: Caribbean cable car to Pico Isabel de Torres — Christ statue and botanical gardens. Closed since June 2024; Consorcio Doma (Doppelmayr, Bartholet, and Grupo Malespín) won the rebuild bid in August 2026 with an 18–20 month construction window. Reopening is expected around 2028 — the gondola is not operating.

title: Cayo Arena — Boat Tours
description: Sandbar island (Cayo Paraíso) reached by boat from Punta Rucia — ~25 minutes each way. Shallow turquoise water, white sand, and snorkeling. Most operators run morning trips.

title: Paseo de Doña Blanca — Pink Street
description: Pedestrian alley painted in every shade of pink — a tribute to Bianca "Doña Blanca" Franceschini, who helped pioneer Puerto Plata tourism from the Hotel Europa in the late 1800s. Victorian-style details, benches, and a favorite backdrop for photos and weddings. Free to stroll between Calle Beller and Calle John F. Kennedy, steps from Parque Independencia.
address: Between Calle Beller & Calle John F. Kennedy

title: Calle de las Sombrillas — Umbrella Street
description: 178 multicolored umbrellas suspended over Calle San Felipe in Puerto Plata's historic center — between Calle Beller and Calle Duarte. Free open-air walkway and one of the city's most photographed spots; browse artisan shops, cafés, and street vendors nearby. About two blocks from Parque Independencia — pair with Paseo de Doña Blanca on a downtown walk.
address: Calle San Felipe, between Calle Beller & Calle Duarte

title: Letrero de Puerto Plata — Photo Letters
description: The city's iconic vertical PUERTO PLATA letters on the Malecón near La Puntilla — free parador fotográfico with Atlantic backdrop. Pair with Fortaleza San Felipe and Anfiteatro La Puntilla on a waterfront walk; best light early morning or late afternoon.
address: Av. Gregorio Luperón (Malecón), near La Puntilla

title: Independence Park — Victorian Downtown Square
description: Puerto Plata's Parque Central (Plaza Independencia) — shaded benches, Victorian façades, and cathedral views in the historic center. Free to stroll anytime; start a downtown walk here toward Paseo de Doña Blanca, Calle de las Sombrillas, and Casa de la Cultura.

title: Independence Park Weekend Plaza Life
description: Weekends at Plaza Independencia — families under the trees, vendors when artisan fairs run, and occasional folkloric music or ballet from Mitur and city programs. Free public square next to the cathedral; check locally for pop-up concerts and seasonal fairs (summer & Holy Week crafts fairs are staples).

title: Fun City Action Park — Go-Karts
description: Fun City Puerto Plata — the Dominican Republic's largest go-kart park on Highway 5 near Playa Dorada. Race Cyclone, Sprint 500, Grand Prix, and bumper cars, or let kids as young as 5 drive with an adult. Playground, pitcher radar challenge, and covered cafeteria on site. Pay per ride or grab an unlimited pass; ~5 minutes from Puerto Plata, ~20 from Sosúa and Cabarete. Tel. (809) 697-0794.

title: Monkeyland Puerto Plata — Safari & Monkeys
description: Half-day jungle excursion in the Imbert hills — open-air safari truck, feed playful squirrel monkeys from a fruit plate, stroll botanical trails with medicinal plants, sample organic coffee and cacao, and visit a traditional countryside home. Hotel pickup from Puerto Plata, Sosúa, Cabarete, and Playa Dorada; book through Runners Adventures or cruise excursions (~4.5 hours).

title: Ocean Zipline at Coconut Cove
description: Soar 1,200 feet over the Atlantic at Chukka Ocean Outpost Coconut Cove — Puerto Plata's only seaside zipline with cliff-to-ocean views, private beach time, and round-trip hotel transfers. ATV, dune buggy, and full-day Damajagua combo packages also book here.

title: Brugal Rum Center — Distillery Tour
description: Tour Puerto Plata's iconic rum distillery — five generations of Brugal family history, copper stills and aging warehouses, then guided tastings of Extra Viejo and other award-winning rums. Weekday visits; check hours before you go.

title: Del Oro Chocolate Factory — Free Tour
description: Free guided tour at Del Oro's working organic chocolate factory in Barrio Las Yaguitas — short film, cacao at every stage, production machinery, and tastings of dark, milk, and white chocolate. Gift shop on site.

title: Del Oro Chocolate Factory — Saturday Tour
description: Saturday morning chocolate factory tours at Del Oro — same free guided walkthrough with tastings and gift shop. Shorter hours than weekdays; arrive early.

title: Hacienda Cufa — Organic Cacao Tour
description: Seven-stop sensory trail on an organic cacao farm in Guananico — planting to artisan chocolate, traditional hot chocolate, choco therapy, Dominican lunch, and a river swim. Call ahead to reserve.

title: Tabacalera Cremo — Factory Tour
description: Walk Puerto Plata's downtown cigar factory on Calle San Felipe — production floor, Cuban master rollers, Mama Juana welcome drink, and a take-home Cremo cigar on the complimentary tour (~1 hour).
time: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sun 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM

title: Tabacalera Cremo — Cigar Rolling Experience
description: Hands-on cigar rolling at Tabacalera Cremo — tobacco sensory session, guided factory walkthrough, roll your own cigar with a Cuban torcedor, cutting and lighting tips, and a photo at the historic Cremo backdrop. ~$125 per person; groups up to 12.
time: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sun 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM

title: Vivonté Cigar Factory — Guided Tour
description: Educational cigar factory tour near Central Park — Dominican cigar history, seed-to-cigar process, fermentation and aging rooms, rolling demo, and how to light and smoke. Mama Juana included on most tours.
address: C. Separación & Calle Prof. Juan Bosch

title: Vivonté Cigar Factory — Saturday Tour
description: Saturday morning cigar factory tours at Vivonté — seed-to-cigar education, aging room visit, and rolling demonstration one block from Central Park. Morning hours only.
address: C. Separación & Calle Prof. Juan Bosch

title: Freestyle Catamaran — Snorkel & Sailing
description: Full-day catamaran from Playa Dorada to Sosúa Bay — two snorkeling stops on the north coast reef, lunch and open bar onboard, and a fun crew keeping the music going. Free hotel pickup from Playa Dorada, Costa Dorada, Sosúa, and Cabarete; confirm your pickup time when you book (~8 hours).

title: Outback Safari — Countryside & Culture
description: All-inclusive day in open-air safari trucks — rural villages, coffee and cacao plantation tastings, a local school visit, and boogie boarding at a hidden beach. Free hotel pickup from Puerto Plata, Sosúa, and Cabarete; confirm meeting details the day before (~8 hours). One of Puerto Plata's classic full-day cultural adventures.

title: Anfiteatro La Puntilla Concerts
description: Outdoor concerts, cultural shows, and carnival troupes at Anfiteatro La Puntilla on the Atlantic — weekend performances on Puerto Plata's Malecón waterfront stage overlooking Fortaleza San Felipe. Admission varies by show (many municipal/Mitur concerts are free; billed artists sell tickets separately). Lineups announced per show.

title: Empowered Women’s Sunset Karaoke
description: Monday sunset karaoke at El Carey Día y Noche’s Patio de Don Ramón — sing, connect, and celebrate with good music, a tropical atmosphere, and happy-hour prices on selected cocktails and drinks. Starts at 6 PM.

title: El Carey Weekend Nightlife
description: Weekend nights at El Carey Día y Noche on Costambar beach — big-screen sports, live DJs, cold drinks, and a local crowd steps from the sand on Calle Reina Isabel.

title: Brugal Rum Center — Group & Corporate Visits
description: Weekday distillery tours at Brugal Rum Center for groups and business visitors — copper stills, aging warehouses, guided tastings, and Dominican rum heritage on the Maimón highway.

title: Museo Judío de Sosúa — Museum Hours
description: Visit the Sosúa Jewish Museum next to Casa Marina — photographs, artifacts, and films on the 1940 refugee settlement that shaped El Batey. Open weekdays; call ahead to confirm hours.

title: Sosúa Bay Diving & Snorkeling
description: Daily reef dives and snorkeling from Sosua Diving Center on La Puntilla — 12+ sites in Sosúa Bay including reefs and wrecks, with certified guides and equipment rental.

title: El Batey Weekend Nightlife
description: Friday and Saturday party nights on Pedro Clisante in El Batey — DJs, dancing, and the highest-energy club scene in downtown Sosúa until the early hours.

title: D-Classico Merengue & Bachata Nights
description: Merengue and bachata dancing at D-Classico in El Batey — local rhythms, live DJs, and one of Sosúa's most authentic Dominican nightlife spots on the main strip.

title: Pedro Clisante Street Food & Dining
description: Evenings on Calle Pedro Clisante in El Batey — open-air restaurants, street grills, and beach-town dining as the main strip closes to traffic and fills with locals and visitors.

title: Natura Cabana Yoga Temple
description: Oceanfront yoga at Natura Cabana's open-air temple in Perla Marina — morning flows and sunset sessions open to hotel guests and visitors. All levels; mats provided.

title: North Coast Saturday Networking
description: Informal expat and entrepreneur networking at the Sea Horse Ranch Saturday Market — founders, remote workers, and locals mingle over artisan food and coffee between Cabarete and Sosúa.
venue: Sea Horse Ranch Tennis Club Lawn

title: Ojo Club Latin Night
description: Thursday Latin Night at Ojo Club above LAX Cabarete — salsa, bachata, and merengue on the rooftop terrace with ocean views. One of Cabarete's best dance nights.

title: Ojo Club Weekend DJ Parties
description: Friday and Saturday DJ parties at Ojo Club on Cabarete Bay — two floors, international and Latin sets, and late-night dancing directly on the beach from 10 PM.

title: La Casita de Papi Beachfront Dining
description: Sunset dinners at La Casita de Papi on Cabarete Central Beach — garlic shrimp paella, grilled catch, and Mediterranean-Caribbean seafood under palm trees on the sand.

title: Liquid Blue Watersports Adventures
description: Daily kite, wing, surf, and eFoil sessions with Liquid Blue on Kite Beach — lessons, rentals, and guided adventures on Cabarete Bay since 2014. Book via WhatsApp +1 849-271-9573.

title: LAX Cabarete Beachfront Concerts
description: Live bands and billed performers on the LAX beach deck — outdoor concerts and special events on Cabarete Bay with sunset views. Check LAX socials for upcoming headliners.

title: VOYVOY Monday Live Music
description: Monday live music and open jam at VOYVOY on Cabarete Bay — Lester Grant hosts, bring an instrument or sit in. Relaxed dinner, drinks, and bay views.

title: Kite Beach Wind Sports Culture
description: Daily wind-sports culture on world-famous Kite Beach — watch pros train, browse beach cafés, and soak in Cabarete's kite and wing heritage along the bay.

title: North Coast Tech & Startup Meetup
description: Remote workers and founders gather at Cowork Cabarete for informal tech talks and networking — weekday desks by day, community meetups and Caribbean Tech discussions after 4 PM.

title: Paella POP — Playa El Pueblito
description: New beachfront Paella POP by Laia & Nico on Playa El Pueblito — soft opening July 5, 2026. Google Maps currently lists this location as temporarily closed with no regular hours yet; dine at Paella POP Green One Playa Dorada until the Pueblito spot reopens.

title: Paella POP at Green One Playa Dorada
description: The original Paella POP kitchen at One Club inside Green One Playa Dorada — traditional paella and Spanish small plates in the golf-resort clubhouse. Pair with a beach day at Long Beach, five minutes away.
venue: One Club, Green One Playa Dorada

title: Spanish Saturday at HMS Valeria
description: Saturday paella nights at HMS Valeria inside Casa Valeria Hotel, Sosúa — signature Paella Valeria, sangria, kalimotxo, and Agua de Valeria. Reserve by phone or WhatsApp +1 809 571 1693.

title: Domingo Dominicano at HMS Valeria
description: Sunday Dominican cuisine at HMS Valeria — spicy goat with white rice and fresh vegetables, plus seafood from the regular menu. Book by phone or WhatsApp +1 809 571 1693.

title: Rum Legacy Museum & Shop Experience
description: Immersive audio-guided museum in Puerto Plata's historic center (opened Feb 2026) — Dominican rum from sugarcane and fermentation to a guided tasting. Free admission; tips welcome. Calle Beller #11A; open daily 9:30 AM–4:30 PM.

title: La Confluencia Ethnographic Gallery
description: Bilingual ethnographic museum in downtown Puerto Plata — Taíno heritage, African roots, Dominican carnival, and the story of the Americas. Calle 12 de Julio #39; open daily 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.

title: Casa Museo General Gregorio Luperón
description: Victorian house-museum honoring the Restoration hero — period furniture, photographs, and a courtyard mural on Calle 12 de Julio. Open Tue–Sun 9:00 AM–5:00 PM (closed Mondays); call +1 809 261 8661 to confirm.

title: Macorix House of Rum — Tours & Tastings
description: Guided rum cellar tour in Puerto Plata — history video, aging barrels, and tastings of Macorix rums. Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–4:00 PM; Saturdays 9:00 AM–12:30 PM; closed Sundays.

title: Casa de la Cultura — Art Exhibitions
description: Rotating visual-art shows, student exhibitions, and cultural talks at Casa de la Cultura Eduardo Brito facing Parque Central — poetry readings, theater, and folkloric dance on the Victorian main stage. Check locally for current openings.
venue: Casa de la Cultura Eduardo Brito

title: Make Authentic Espadrilles Workshop
description: Two-hour hands-on workshop at Handmade the Brand on Calle Duarte 37 — choose your base, stitching, and laces from 100k+ combinations, then stitch your own pair with master artisans. Snacks during the session and a glass of cava at the end (non-alcoholic drinks available); all materials and tools included. From €99.90. Weekday sessions 10 AM–12 PM and 2–4 PM; book on Eventbrite.

title: The Piña Colada Experience
description: Adults-only 2-hour cocktail workshop at Handmade the Brand on Calle Duarte 37 (corner of Umbrella Street) — welcome coconut rum, the story of the piña colada, then hollow a fresh pineapple and blend your own all-natural cocktail. Homemade tropical rum tastings, music, and photo ops included. From ~US$116; max 15 guests. Book ahead; arrive on time (entry closes 15 minutes after start).

title: Natura Cabana Saturday Live Music
description: Free Saturday live music at Natura Cabana's beachfront restaurant in Perla Marina (7–9:30 PM) — acoustic, jazz, and Caribbean fusion with dinner and drinks. No cover.

title: Shaka Bar Thursday Karaoke at El Parq
description: Karaoke every Thursday at Shaka Bar in El Parq Foodpark near Encuentro, hosted by Francesca Crystals. Sing from 7:30–9:30 PM among the open-air food stalls and Cabarete crowd.

title: Noche Latina by Ninafrika Dance
description: Ninafrika Dance leads Noche Latina every Friday at Encuentro Food Park (El Parq) — weekly social dancing from 7 PM among the open-air food stalls.

title: El Parq Saturday Live Bands
description: Saturday live bands at El Parq Foodpark — local and regional acts while you eat and drink in Cabarete's open-air food park near Encuentro.

title: Blue Ice Saturday Gogo Dance
description: Every Saturday gogo dance night at Blue Ice Piano Bar & Restaurant on Calle Dr. Rosen in El Batey, Sosúa — DJ Chimbala and late-night tables. Reserve on WhatsApp +1 829-797-7856.
address: Calle Dr. Rosen, El Batey, Sosúa

title: Parada Típica El Choco Tuesday Live
description: Every Tuesday from 5:00 PM at Parada Típica El Choco on the Sosúa–Cabarete road (opposite Ocean Village / Plaza Buen Gusto) — aperitivo with free finger food at the table, house music, and a different live band each week. RSVP / book a table: 809-804-2510.
address: Carretera principal Sosúa–Cabarete (vis-à-vis Ocean Village / Plaza Buen Gusto)

title: Zumba at GYM SOV
description: Morning classes with Raffaella at GYM SOV (Sosúa Ocean Village) — Tuesday Zumba Fitness and Thursday Zumba + Lift Tone Up (weights and yoga mats). Latin/pop dance cardio, adults welcome, no gym membership required. 9:00–10:00 AM; book or confirm on WhatsApp +1 829 519 1974.
address: Carretera Sosúa–Cabarete Km 2, Sosúa Ocean Village

title: Sunday Malecón with the City
description: Sunday family afternoon on Puerto Plata's Malecón — municipal cultural pop-ups, folkloric music, and waterfront strolls programmed with the Ayuntamiento and Mitur. Free public programming; look for tents near the PUERTO PLATA letters and Anfiteatro La Puntilla. Typical hours 4–8 PM.

title: Casa de la Cultura Saturday Stage
description: Saturday cultural programs at Casa de la Cultura Eduardo Brito on Parque Central — student recitals, poetry, folkloric dance, and chamber talks that overflow the weekday exhibition hours. Free entry; check the board on Calle Separación for the day's stage time.
venue: Casa de la Cultura Eduardo Brito

title: Anfiteatro La Puntilla Weekday Culture
description: Weekday municipal and Mitur cultural presentations at Anfiteatro La Puntilla — school showcases, folkloric ballet, and community recitals on the Atlantic stage between billed weekend concerts. Many midweek slots are free; confirm the day's program at the waterfront box office.

title: Mecla'o Rooftop Live Music
description: Rooftop lounge on Av. Luis Ginebra with regular live music, cocktails, and city views. Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday 6:00 PM–2:00 AM; Friday–Saturday 6:00 PM–4:00 AM. Closed Mondays. Typical spend DOP 500–1,000.

title: Terraza Ocean World & Casino
description: Evening terrace, drinks, and casino at the Ocean World marina in Cofresí — harbor views after the day park closes, snacks, screens, and a mixed local/visitor crowd. Terrace listed open daily from 9:00 AM; nightlife runs later.

title: Kviar Show Disco & Casino
description: Casino tables, DJ sets, and late dancing at Kviar Grand Oasis Marien in Costa Dorada. Official hours daily 2:00 PM–4:00 AM. Call +1 809 320 1632.
address: Carretera Luperón Km. 4.5, Complejo turístico Costa Dorada, Puerto Plata

title: Iberostar Waves Costa Dorada Day Pass
description: All-inclusive day pass at Iberostar Waves Costa Dorada — three outdoor pools, beach sunbed (subject to availability), unlimited food and drinks, kids’ pool, non-motorized water sports, gym, and Star Camp (ages 4–12, reservation required). Pools 9:00 AM–6:00 PM. From US$65 adult / US$33 child (2–12); under 2 free. Book on Iberostar Local Experiences. Next to Kviar / Be Live Marien in Costa Dorada. Hotel closed 30 Aug–26 Oct 2026 for refurbishment — book by 29 Aug or after 26 Oct.
address: Carretera Luperón Km 4, Costa Dorada, Puerto Plata

title: Cofresí Beach Sunset Walk
description: Family evening stroll on Cofresí Beach west of Puerto Plata — sunset over the bay, snack shacks along the sand, and an easy walk beside the Ocean World marina. No ticket; bring cash for beach snacks.

title: Laguna SOV Family Water Park
description: Kids’ amusement and family water park inside Sosúa Ocean Village (Carretera Sosúa–Cabarete km 2) — slides, inflatables, kids’ water park, and pools. Daily 10:00 AM–6:00 PM. Day pass RD$700 adults (15+), RD$600 children (3–14), under 3 free; VIP zone RD$1,500. Food not included; you may bring your own. WhatsApp +1 829 961-2269.
address: Carretera Sosúa–Cabarete km 2, Sosúa Ocean Village

title: Santa Fe Day Pass
description: Oceanfront recreation club inside Sosúa Ocean Village — colonial fortress, pools, waterfalls, and the Santa Maria ship restaurant (Mexican/Asian/Dominican). Weekdays 10:00 AM–7:00 PM; weekends and holidays 11:00 AM–9:00 PM. Day-pass rates are consumable at the restaurant/bar and change by weekday vs weekend — buy tickets at pasadia.santafe.do. This is not Restaurant Maria.
address: Ocean Village Deluxe, Sosúa Ocean Village, Sosúa 57000

title: Restaurant Maria Day Pass
description: Oceanfront gourmet dining at Club House Maria in Ocean Village Deluxe — infinity pool and jacuzzis overlooking the Atlantic. Open daily 8:00 AM–10:00 PM. Day pass is available every day for the pools (owners and tenants free); confirm current consumable rates when you book. Reservations WhatsApp +1 829 961-4455. Not Santa Maria, the ship restaurant inside Santa Fe.
address: Carretera Sosúa–Cabarete km 2, Ocean Village Deluxe, Sosúa 57000

title: Crazy Lobster Beach Grill
description: Beach-hut seafood at Crazy Lobster on Playa Los Cocos in Maimón — grilled lobster, Dominican plates, and patio or sand tables a short walk from Senator Puerto Plata, Playabachata, and Amber Cove. Typical lunch through early evening; call +1 809-749-6917 to confirm hours.

title: Don Limón Cuban Kitchen
description: Cuban tables on Playa Cofresí — sandwiches, grilled fish, paella, and mojitos at family-run Don Limón, just west of Puerto Plata near Ocean World. Open daily 11:00 AM–1:00 AM. Call +1 809-215-7676.

title: El Cocotazo Cafe Beachfront Breakfast & Lunch
description: Daytime beach tables at El Cocotazo Cafe on Kite Beach (Agualina Kitebeach Hotel) — Dominican breakfast, tacos, and salads facing the kite line. Kitchen 9:00 AM–4:45 PM; happy hour 4:00–5:00 PM. Family-run by José Luis and Manuel. Confirm hours at +1 809-657-6116.
address: Agualina Kitebeach Hotel, Carretera Principal, Kite Beach

title: Costambar Beach Fitness
description: Free beach fitness on Costambar sand, to the left of El Carey Restaurant. Classes restart Monday 31 August 2026, then Monday–Friday 9:00–10:00 AM. Strength, coordination, balance, and cardio on weekdays; yoga on Fridays. All genders welcome — bring light hand weights, a yoga mat, and water; it is still hot.
address: Costambar beach, to the left of El Carey Restaurant, Calle Reina Isabel

title: Waterfront Playa Alicia Sunset Dining
description: Oceanfront dinners on Playa Alicia in El Batey — Caribbean-international kitchen, cocktails, and Sosúa's best sunset terrace over the bay. Open daily 8:00 AM–10:00 PM; walk-ins welcome, WhatsApp +1 809-571-3024 for a rail table.
address: Calle Dr. Rosen, esq. Calle Sin Salida, El Batey

title: Waterfront Playa Alicia Friday Jazz
description: Live jazz on the Playa Alicia terrace every Friday — sunset over the bay, dinner service, and the week's standing music night at Waterfront. Confirm the set time when you book.
address: Calle Dr. Rosen, esq. Calle Sin Salida, El Batey

title: Río Soñador at Finca Papirucho
description: The most accessible river day from Sosúa — swim the Soñador pools (El Palo, La Cortina), then use bathrooms, restaurant, and lockers at Finca Papirucho. Weekdays are quieter than weekends. GPS to Finca Papirucho; the last stretch is dirt with cement patches.

title: Sunset Grill at Velero Beachfront Dining
description: Beachfront restaurant at Velero Beach Resort on Calle La Punta — open to hotel guests and the public, international/island kitchen, and Cabarete Bay sunset tables. Daily ~8:00 AM–10:00 PM; reserve +1 809-571-9727.
address: Calle La Punta 1, Velero Beach Resort

title: Sunset Grill Sushi Nights
description: Sushi menu every Wednesday and Thursday from 3:00 PM at Sunset Grill on Cabarete Bay — nigiri, sashimi, and rolls with ocean views. Reserve +1 809-571-9727.
address: Calle La Punta 1, Velero Beach Resort

title: Charco de los Militares Guided Hike
description: Cascading turquoise pools in the Tubagua hills — guided farm-and-forest hike (~45–60 min) or 4×4 approach; deepest charco ~17 ft. Book via Tubagua Eco Lodge (+1 809-413-9058); not a DIY walk-up. Better without small kids.

title: La Rejoya Canyon Trek
description: Wild Camú River trek near Juan de Nina — muddy crossings, forest pools, and a deep waterfall basin (~1–1.5 hr each way). Guide strongly recommended; book small groups via Tubagua Eco Lodge (+1 809-413-9058). Respect the community water source.

title: Río Martinico (Madre Vieja)
description: Sosúa's lesser-known river day in Madre Vieja — locals also call it Río Azul. Near-road access toward the Yásica corridor, serene swimming, local crowd. Ask residents for today's swim stretch; weekdays quieter; pack out trash.
